threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know they’re fresh when they ask if there’s a direct bus to the High Street instead of using the Overground. Classic rookie mistake.
Caught a late 59 last night; the driver stopped to help a lost tourist find their way to Clapham. Touch of kindness amid the usual chaos.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a man in a full suit trying to order a kebab at 3 AM while a group of kids cycled by, I knew Neukölln was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how the U-Bahn stations here often have art installations that feel like they're part of the furniture? It's like traveling through an underground gallery daily.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their calm in the BART chaos. Tourists are panicking over delays; locals are checking Twitter casually while sipping a Pisco Sour.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with no air conditioning today; crowd was half drenched in sweat and half entertaining themselves with sing-alongs. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think Gràcia is all about Gaudí. It's the little corner bars and family cafes that keep its heart beating, not just the tourist traps.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they always look lost trying to decipher the Metro map; locals just know to follow the color lines.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground'—everyone knows you take the Overground from here.
Caught the 133 last night—two guys were arguing about whether pineapple belongs on pizza. It got so heated the driver had to step in.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids trading Pokémon cards by the canal while a couple of old folks argued over the best döner in town. Pure Neukölln magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a currywurst stand serving vegan options alongside traditional meat, all while a street artist paints a mural next door.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only true locals know that the taco truck on 24th and Mission has better carne asada than any sit-down place. Tourists line up for the trendy spots.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading commuters on the 31-Greenwood, clutching a ukulele. Muni, with the right soundtrack, can feel like a live show sometimes.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the Gaudí hype, but they miss the real charm in the local plazas where the neighbours actually gather.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their fresh enthusiasm for the local vermut bars—standing at the counter, deeply studying the menu like it's a treasure map.
